intro: July 2 is the most binary session of the year: NFP June (consensus ~172K) at 8:30 AM ET, followed by markets closing July 3 (observed July 4) and a 3-day holiday gap July 3–6. The July 1 session is a live gate test — if closes confirm SPX >7,460 + VIX <17 + NVDA >$200 on >200M volume simultaneously (first time since May 14 ATH), the BUY signal activates for July 2. But even with gate clearance, re-entering full size into the NFP binary is ill-advised. The session structure: (1) If July 1 gates confirmed → initiate partial longs (NVDA 25–35%, SPY/MU); NFP July 2 Goldilocks = add the rest at July 7 open. (2) If July 1 gates failed → maintain step-aside; watch NFP for the first post-holiday re-entry setup. BTC intraday breach of $58,100 ($57,802 low, Crypto.com MCP) and SK Hynix KOSPI Gate 1 failure warn that risk appetite is bifurcated — US equities near all-time highs while crypto/Korea in distribution. SPCX Bond distribution Day 8: volume read is the data point for whether clearance arrives before Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.timeframe: 1–2 days conditional; full position July 7 post-NFP
ideas.idea: Conditional BUY: If July 1 CLOSING data confirms SPX >7,460 AND VIX <17 AND NVDA >$200 on >200M shares simultaneously — initiate 25–35% of target NVDA position at July 2 open. Hold through NFP July 2 with a hard stop at $195 intraday. If NFP is Goldilocks (130–170K, wages +0.2%): add remaining 65–75% at July 7 open. If gates did NOT close: watch-only; next entry is post-NFP July 7. Do NOT size full position before NFP resolution regardless of gate outcome.
ideas.why: July 1 pre-market data shows the closest approach to triple-gate clearance since May 14 ATH: NVDA $200.63 intraday, SPX 7,494 intraday, VIX 16.27 intraday. Volume at ~166M is the critical gating factor — if today's session closes above 200M shares with NVDA above $200, the explicit re-entry framework activates for the first time in over six weeks. The underlying AI capex thesis (Blackwell B300 ramp, sovereign AI, hyperscaler demand) has not weakened. The mandatory exit preserved capital through a 10-session distributional ceiling — re-entering on a confirmed gate close is the discipline working as designed.
ideas.trigger: July 1 CLOSING data confirming all three gates simultaneously. Specific: SPX final print >7,460, VIX final print <17.00, NVDA final print >$200.00 on final volume >200M shares. If any one of these three conditions is not met, do NOT initiate. Check closing data at 4:15 PM ET July 1.
ideas.risk: NFP July 2 blowout (+200K+, wages +0.4%) reverses gate clearance immediately — VIX spikes above 17, SPX falls through 7,460; partial NVDA position absorbed into NFP headwind; markets close July 3 removing exit ability. Volume failure: NVDA closes above $200 but on <200M shares — price gate cleared but volume gate not; framework ambiguous.

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.idea: Buy MU on any dip below $1,200 on July 2 if regime gates confirmed at July 1 close. MU is the cleanest AI semi re-entry: Q3 FY26 +15.7% earnings beat (June 26), HBM4 sold out through 2026, $50B Q4 FY26 guide (~40% above prior consensus), no forced-exit overhang (unlike NVDA), no ADR mechanics (unlike SK Hynix). The NFP day creates the ideal entry point — any NFP-day volatility dip is a buying opportunity in a gate-cleared regime.
ideas.why: Samsung's $226B AI data center commitment and Micron's $50B Q4 FY26 guide are confirmed independently — HBM4 demand is a supply-constrained structural driver. US domestic manufacturing (Idaho fab) provides geopolitical differentiation that Korean competitors cannot match for US government AI procurement. In a regime-cleared environment post-NFP Goldilocks, MU is the highest-conviction AI semi add given the recent Q3 earnings confirmation removing execution uncertainty for two quarters.
ideas.trigger: July 1 SPX/VIX gates confirmed at close (both regime gates) → buy MU on any dip below $1,200 on July 2 or July 7. If gates not confirmed: wait for post-NFP July 7 session as entry. Size 25–40% of AI semi allocation below $1,200.
ideas.risk: NFP July 2 blowout cements BofA three-hike framework; MU gaps below $1,200 entry zone on the adverse print; holiday gap July 3–6 prevents exit until July 7. HBM demand cycle peaks earlier than expected in H1 2027, compressing MU's FY27 guide.

ideas.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
ideas.timeframe: 1–5 days (conditional on July 1 close confirmation + Goldilocks NFP)
ideas.idea: Buy SPY if July 1 session closes confirm SPX >7,460 AND VIX <17 for the first time since May 14 ATH. The Q3 Day 1 regime upgrade from HOLD to BUY is the first signal of its kind since the ATH. Q3 historically follows the best quarter since 2020 with 2–4 weeks of momentum. Target: SPX 7,550–7,600 before July CPI.
ideas.why: SPX has closed below 7,460 for 10 consecutive sessions despite four sequential macro tailwinds (June 26 reconstitution, June 29 Samsung/SCOTUS/Iran, June 30 Q2 window dressing, July 1 Q3 open). The 11th failed attempt to clear the gate produces continuation risk; the first successful close above 7,460 triggers the BUY upgrade with all the pent-up institutional demand from step-aside funds. ADP June and ISM Manufacturing (both July 1) provide the final pre-NFP data confirming the Goldilocks labor market narrative.
ideas.trigger: July 1 confirmed close: SPX >7,460 AND VIX <17 simultaneously. Add 15–20% of gross at July 2 open. Hold through NFP July 2; on Goldilocks print, add another 10–15% at the NFP reaction.
ideas.risk: SPX closes below 7,460 for 11th consecutive session (gates fail again); July 1 intraday gate tests fail to produce closing confirmation; NFP July 2 hot print (>200K) reverses gate clearance before position can be profitably closed into the July 3 closure.

ideas.name: Alphabet Inc.
ideas.idea: GOOGL is the cleanest large-cap buy in a regime-clearing scenario. Dow Jones inclusion (June 29 first Dow day +5%) creates persistent systematic demand from all 44 Dow-tracking ETFs and funds for 2–4 weeks. AI Search monetization thesis confirmed (Q1 2026 Search revenue accelerating post-AI Mode launch). SCOTUS Fed independence ruling (June 29) removed the last major US regulatory overhang. July 1 gate clearance is the activation catalyst for full GOOGL add.
ideas.why: GOOGL's Dow inclusion creates the largest persistent price-weighting advantage of any recent Dow addition (~7x Verizon's prior weighting). Every rebalancing over the next 2–4 weeks adds GOOGL demand. Waymo's SF and LA commercial operations represent $100B+ of unvalued optionality. Q2 2026 earnings (late July) will be the first quarter fully reflecting Dow inclusion flows and AI Search monetization at scale. The SCOTUS ruling removes the regulatory tail that kept GOOGL at a discount to META and MSFT.
ideas.trigger: July 1 regime gates confirm (SPX >7,460, VIX <17) → add GOOGL at July 2 open. 15–20% of big-tech allocation. Stop at $339 (below June 30 low). Target: $220–$230 pre-Q2 earnings.
ideas.risk: DOJ antitrust search remedies (user choice screen mandates) materially reduce Search revenue before Q2 earnings; AI Search AI Mode cannibalizes clicks faster than AI ad placements compensate; broader regime fails (gates don't clear July 1).

ideas.name: Bitcoin
ideas.idea: BTC flat/cash — Day 11 of exit gate sequence. $57,802 intraday low (Crypto.com MCP confirmed) breached $58,100 structural support for the first time. BTC is currently $58,647 — recovered above support — but the intraday breach is the deepest support test of the distribution window. Watch the July 1 UTC midnight close: above $58,100 = support reclaim; below = $57,500 activated. NFP July 2 + holiday gap prohibits any re-entry before July 7.
ideas.why: The $58,100 breach is the most bearish technical development in 11 sessions. The June 25 exact test ($58,100.00 low) and June 30 near-miss ($58,186) preceded today's confirmed breach ($57,802). The distribution pattern is clear: lower lows on each test. Without IBIT inflow reversal (no positive flow day in 11 sessions) and with NFP into holiday gap, the structural case for a flat/cash posture is stronger than ever. However, the recovery from $57,802 to $58,647 within the same session suggests buyer demand exists at sub-$58,000 — watch for an intraday capitulation pattern that precedes medium-term bottoms in post-halving cycles.
ideas.trigger: Two consecutive UTC midnight closes above $62,000 AND IBIT daily net inflows for 3+ consecutive sessions AND post-NFP clarity (July 2). Earliest realistic window: July 7–8 if Goldilocks NFP. Even then: do NOT re-enter if July 1 UTC midnight close was below $58,100 without two subsequent closes above $58,100 first.
ideas.risk: BTC gaps through $62,000 on July 7 risk-on post-Goldilocks NFP without giving the two-gate sequence time to confirm; NFP July 2 adverse print drives BTC below $57,500 from a forced early re-entry; IBIT inflow confirmation lags 2 days (T+2) creating uncertainty gap.

ideas.name: SpaceX
ideas.timeframe: 2–3 weeks (through Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 and clearance July 9–11)
ideas.idea: Step aside HIGH conviction — do NOT re-enter on July 2 regardless of session outcome. Bond distribution Day 8. Day 7 volume was 82.05M (above Day 6 estimate, confirming non-monotonic decline driven by Nasdaq 100 pre-positioning). $170.86 est. close is $14.14 below $185 re-entry gate. Watch Day 8 volume (July 2 = NFP day) as the critical read: if volume drops to 20–40M despite NFP volatility, clearance is accelerating; above 60M = distribution persists.
ideas.why: The Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 ($4.3B passive) is 3 trading sessions away. Pre-positioning demand (today's +4.07%) is being offset by residual bond distribution supply. The Russell 1000 June 26 template (Day 4 passive absorbed intraday) is the framework: Day 10 Nasdaq 100 inclusion will be absorbed if distribution volume >15M on July 7. Clearance (5M/day for 2–3 sessions) now projected July 9–11. The re-entry gate at $185 requires clearance FIRST, then two consecutive $185+ closes.
ideas.trigger: Volume below 5M shares/day for 2–3 consecutive sessions (clearance confirmed) THEN two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. Clearance est. July 9–11; $185 gate tests est. July 11–14. Monitor Day 8 (July 2, NFP day) and Day 9 (July 6, first post-holiday) volumes as leading indicators.
ideas.risk: Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 fully absorbed intraday (Russell 1000 template repeats) with no post-inclusion sustained move above $185; NFP July 2 adverse print drives SPCX to $150 IG floor on July 6 open; re-entry gate from $185 to $175 is NOT warranted — discipline must hold.

ideas.name: Meta Platforms
ideas.idea: META is the second-cleanest big-tech buy in a regime-clearing scenario behind GOOGL. AI ad targeting improvements are compounding CPM expansion in real time across 3.3B daily active users. LLaMA 4 open-source flywheel creates developer ecosystem lock-in. Q2 2026 earnings (late July) will be the first full-quarter read on AI monetization at scale — the setup for a 'beat and raise' is strong given AI ad targeting implementations.
ideas.why: META's revenue model has zero lag between AI improvement and monetization: every increment in ad-targeting precision via AI directly improves CPM for 3.3B users. Unlike MSFT (enterprise sales cycle) or GOOGL (Search cannibalization risk), META's AI monetization is instantaneous. FCF generation makes META rate-resilient in a FOMC hawkish hold environment through 2027–2028. The EU AI Act compliance costs are real but sized ($2–3B one-time) relative to META's $60B+ annual FCF.
ideas.trigger: July 1 regime gates confirmed (SPX >7,460, VIX <17) → add META at July 2 open. 15–20% of big-tech allocation. Target: new ATH before Q2 earnings.
ideas.risk: EU AI Act imposes discriminatory compliance burden; Apple iOS privacy framework deterioration (ATT 3.0 hypothetical); Q2 earnings miss on ad revenue from economic slowdown; broader regime fails (gates don't clear July 1).
